facts.fact: The national CERT, coordinated by the CSA, recorded 3,876 cybersecurity incidents between January and July 2026, about 47 percent online fraud, as cited at the NCSAM 2026 opening.

The CSA marked its fifth anniversary and its Director-General opened NCSAM 2026; a national CERT is coordinated by the CSA and the public can report incidents to it; published date used as the opening date is not stated.
